value.statement: Qin killed over four hundred thousand of Zhao Kuo's soldiers at Changping
Qin captured King An and annexed Han

sourceDate.text: 韓厥之感晉景公，紹趙孤之子武

units.zh: 韓之先與周同姓，姓姬氏。
units.en: The ancestors of the Han shared the same surname as the Zhou royal house—they were of the Ji clan.
units.literal: The Han ancestors shared the same surname as the Zhou royal house, the Ji clan.

units.zh: 其後苗裔事晉，得封於韓原，曰韓武子。
units.en: Their later descendants served the state of Jin and received a fief at Hanyuan. The first lord of that line was known as Han Wuzi.
units.literal: Later descendants served Jin, obtained enfeoffment at Han Yuan, and were called Han wuzi.

units.zh: 武子後三世有韓厥，從封姓為韓氏。
units.en: Three generations after Wuzi, there arose Han Jue, who took the surname Han from his fief.
units.literal: Three generations after wuzi there was Han Jue, who from his enfeoffment took the surname Han clan.

units.zh: 韓厥，晉景公之三年，晉司寇屠岸賈將作亂，誅靈公之賊趙盾。
units.en: In the third year of Duke Jing of Jin, the Minister of Justice Tu'an Jia plotted to carry out a purge, intending to punish Zhao Dun for the assassination of Duke Ling.
units.literal: Han Jue, in Jin Jing Gong's third year, the Jin Si Kou Tu An Jia was about to rebel and execute Ling Gong's traitor Zhao Dun.

units.zh: 趙盾已死矣，欲誅其子趙朔。
units.en: Zhao Dun was already dead, so Tu'an Jia sought to execute his son, Zhao Shuo.
units.literal: Zhao Dun was already dead, and they desired to execute his son Zhao Shuo.

units.zh: 韓厥止賈，賈不聽。
units.en: Han Jue tried to dissuade him, but Tu'an Jia would not listen.
units.literal: Han Jue tried to stop Jia, but Jia would not listen.

units.zh: 厥告趙朔令亡。
units.en: Han Jue warned Zhao Shuo and urged him to flee.
units.literal: Jue told Zhao Shuo to flee.

units.zh: 朔曰：「子必能不絕趙祀，死不恨矣。」
units.en: Zhao Shuo said, "If you can ensure that the Zhao sacrifices are not extinguished, I will die without regret."
units.literal: Shuo said, "If you, sir, can ensure the Zhao sacrifices are not cut off, I shall die without regret."

units.zh: 韓厥許之。
units.en: Han Jue gave him his word.
units.literal: Han Jue promised him.

units.zh: 及賈誅趙氏，厥稱疾不出。
units.en: When Tu'an Jia massacred the Zhao clan, Han Jue feigned illness and stayed away.
units.literal: When Jia executed the Zhao clan, Jue claimed illness and did not go out.

units.zh: 程嬰、公孫杵臼之藏趙孤趙武也，厥知之。
units.en: When Cheng Ying and Gongsun Chujiu hid the orphan Zhao Wu, Han Jue knew of it.
units.literal: Cheng Ying and Gongsun Chu Jiu hid the Zhao orphan Zhao Wu, and Jue knew it.

units.zh: 景公十一年，厥與郤克將兵八百乘伐齊，敗齊頃公于鞍，獲逢丑父。
units.en: In the eleventh year of Duke Jing, Han Jue and Xi Ke led an army of eight hundred chariots against Qi, defeated Duke Qing of Qi at the Battle of An, and captured Feng Choufu.
units.literal: In Jing Gong's eleventh year, Jue and Xi Ke led eight hundred chariots to attack Qi, defeated Qi Qing Gong at An, and captured Feng Chou Fu.

units.zh: 於是晉作六卿，而韓厥在一卿之位，號為獻子。
units.en: At that time, Jin established the system of six ministers, and Han Jue held one of those positions. He was styled Xianzi.
units.literal: Thus, Jin established the six ministers, and Han Jue held one of the ministerial positions, called Xian Zi.

units.zh: 晉景公十七年，病，卜大業之不遂者為祟。
units.en: In the seventeenth year of Duke Jing of Jin, the duke fell ill. A divination revealed that the spirits of those whose great works had been cut short were causing the affliction.
units.literal: In Jin Jing Gong's seventeenth year, he fell ill. They divined that spirits were causing harm because great enterprises were not succeeding.

units.zh: 韓厥稱趙成季之功，今後無祀，以感景公。
units.en: Han Jue spoke of the merits of Zhao Chengji, pointing out that his descendants now had no one to carry on the ancestral sacrifices. This moved Duke Jing deeply.
units.literal: Han Jue cited Zhao Cheng Ji's merits, saying that now his descendants had no sacrifices, to move Jing Gong.

units.zh: 景公問曰：「尚有世乎？」
units.en: Duke Jing asked, "Are there still descendants of the Zhao line?"
units.literal: Jing Gong asked, "Are there still descendants?"

units.zh: 厥於是言趙武，而復與故趙氏田邑，續趙氏祀。
units.en: Han Jue then spoke of Zhao Wu, and the former lands and towns of the Zhao clan were restored to him, so that the Zhao ancestral sacrifices might continue.
units.literal: Jue thus spoke of Zhao Wu, restored the former Zhao clan's fields and cities, and continued the Zhao clan sacrifices.

units.zh: 晉悼公之（十）［七］年，韓獻子老。
units.en: In the seventh year of Duke Dao of Jin, Han Xianzi had grown old.
units.literal: In Jin Dao Gong's seventh year, Han Xian Zi grew old.

units.zh: 獻子卒，子宣子代。
units.en: When Xianzi died, his son Xuanzi succeeded him.
units.literal: Xian Zi died, and his son Xuan Zi succeeded him.

units.zh: 宣子徙居州。
units.en: Xuanzi moved his residence to Zhou.
units.literal: Xuan Zi moved his residence to Zhou.

units.zh: 晉平公十四年，吳季札使晉，曰：「晉國之政卒歸於韓、魏、趙矣。」
units.en: In the fourteenth year of Duke Ping of Jin, Ji Zha of Wu came as an envoy to Jin and declared, "The governance of Jin will ultimately fall to the houses of Han, Wei, and Zhao."
units.literal: In the fourteenth year of Duke Ping of Jin, Ji Zha of Wu came as envoy to Jin and said, "The governance of Jin will ultimately fall to Han, Wei, and Zhao."

units.zh: 晉頃公十二年，韓宣子與趙、魏共分祁氏、羊舌氏十縣。
units.en: In the twelfth year of Duke Qing of Jin, Han Xuanzi, together with the Zhao and Wei houses, divided among themselves the ten counties belonging to the Qi and Yangshe clans.
units.literal: In Jin Qing Gong's twelfth year, Han Xuan Zi, with Zhao and Wei, together divided the ten counties of the Qi clan and Yang She clan.

units.zh: 晉定公十五年，宣子與趙簡子侵伐范、中行氏。
units.en: During the fifteenth year of Duke Ding of Jin, Xuanzi and Zhao Jianzi launched an attack against the Fan and Zhonghang clans.
units.literal: In Jin Ding Gong's fifteenth year, Xuan Zi and Zhao Jian Zi invaded and attacked the Fan and Zhong Hang clans.

units.zh: 宣子卒，子貞子代立。
units.en: After Xuanzi's death, his son Zhenzi succeeded him.
units.literal: Xuan Zi died, and his son Zhen Zi succeeded and was established.

units.zh: 貞子徙居平陽。
units.en: Zhenzi moved his residence to Pingyang.
units.literal: Zhen Zi moved his residence to Ping Yang.

units.zh: 貞子卒，子簡子代。
units.en: At Zhenzi's death, his son Jianzi succeeded him.
units.literal: Zhen Zi died, and his son Jian Zi succeeded.

units.zh: 簡子卒，子莊子代。
units.en: Jianzi was succeeded by his son Zhuangzi.
units.literal: Jian Zi died, and his son Zhuang Zi succeeded.

units.zh: 莊子卒，子康子代。
units.en: Zhuangzi was succeeded by his son Kangzi.
units.literal: Zhuang Zi died, and his son Kang Zi succeeded.

units.zh: 康子與趙襄子、魏桓子共敗知伯，分其地，地益大，大於諸侯。
units.en: Kangzi, together with Zhao Xiangzi and Wei Huanzi, defeated Zhi Bo, divided his territory among themselves, and so their domains grew ever larger—surpassing those of many feudal lords.
units.literal: Kang Zi, with Zhao Xiang Zi and Wei Huan Zi, together defeated Zhi Bo, divided his territory, and their land became increasingly great, greater than the other feudal lords.

units.zh: 康子卒，子武子代。
units.en: At Kangzi's death, his son Wuzi succeeded him.
units.literal: Kang Zi died, and his son wuzi succeeded.

units.zh: 武子二年，伐鄭，殺其君幽公。
units.en: In the second year of Wuzi, they attacked Zheng and killed its lord, Duke You.
units.literal: In wuzi's second year, they attacked Zheng and killed their lord You Gong.

units.zh: 十六年，武子卒，子景侯立。
units.en: In the sixteenth year, Wuzi died and his son, Marquis Jing, came to power.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year, wuzi died, and his son Jing Hou was established.

units.zh: 景侯虔元年，伐鄭，取雍丘。
units.en: In the first year of Marquis Jing Qian, they attacked Zheng and captured Yongqiu.
units.literal: In Jing Hou Qian's first year, they attacked Zheng and took Yong Qiu.

units.zh: 二年，鄭敗我負黍。
units.en: The next year, Zheng defeated Han forces at Fushu.
units.literal: In the second year, Zheng defeated us at Fu Shu.

units.zh: 六年，與趙、魏俱得列為諸侯。
units.en: By the sixth year, Han, together with Zhao and Wei, gained formal recognition among the feudal lords.
units.literal: In the sixth year, with Zhao and Wei they together obtained recognition as feudal lords.

units.zh: 九年，鄭圍我陽翟。
units.en: During the ninth year, Zheng besieged Han's city of Yangdi.
units.literal: In the ninth year, Zheng besieged our Yang Di.

units.zh: 景侯卒，子列侯取立。
units.en: When Marquis Jing died, his son Marquis Lie Qu came to power.
units.literal: Jing Hou died, and his son Lie Hou Qu was established.

units.zh: 列侯三年，聶政殺韓相俠累。
units.en: In the third year of Marquis Lie, the assassin Nie Zheng killed the Han chancellor Xia Lei.
units.literal: In Lie Hou's third year, Nie Zheng killed the Han chancellor Xia Lei.

units.zh: 九年，秦伐我宜陽，取六邑。
units.en: In the ninth year, Qin attacked Han's Yiyang and seized six towns.
units.literal: In the ninth year, Qin attacked our Yi Yang and took six cities.

units.zh: 十三年，列侯卒，子文侯立。
units.en: In the thirteenth year, Marquis Lie died and his son, Marquis Wen, succeeded him.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year, Lie Hou died, and his son Wen Hou was established.

units.zh: 是歲魏文侯卒。
units.en: That same year, Marquis Wen of Wei also died.
units.literal: This year Wei Wen Hou died.

units.zh: 文侯二年，伐鄭，取陽城。
units.en: During Marquis Wen's second year, they attacked Zheng and captured Yangcheng.
units.literal: In Wen Hou's second year, they attacked Zheng and took Yang Cheng.

units.zh: 伐宋，到彭城，執宋君。
units.en: They attacked Song, marched to Pengcheng, and captured the lord of Song.
units.literal: They attacked Song, arrived at Peng Cheng, and seized the Song jun.

units.zh: 七年，伐齊，至桑丘。
units.en: During the seventh year, they attacked Qi and advanced as far as Sangqiu.
units.literal: In the seventh year, they attacked Qi and arrived at Sang Qiu.

units.zh: 鄭反晉。
units.en: Zheng revolted against Jin.
units.literal: Zheng rebelled against Jin.

units.zh: 九年，伐齊，至靈丘。
units.en: Two years later, they attacked Qi and advanced as far as Lingqiu.
units.literal: In the ninth year, they attacked Qi and arrived at Ling Qiu.

units.zh: 十年，文侯卒，子哀侯立。
units.en: In the tenth year, Marquis Wen died and his son, Marquis Ai, succeeded him.
units.literal: In the tenth year, Wen Hou died, and his son Ai Hou was established.

units.zh: 哀侯元年，與趙、魏分晉國。
units.en: In the first year of Marquis Ai, Han, together with Zhao and Wei, partitioned the state of Jin.
units.literal: In Ai Hou's first year, with Zhao and Wei they divided the Jin state.

units.zh: 二年，滅鄭，因徙都鄭。
units.en: The following year, they conquered Zheng and moved the Han capital there.
units.literal: In the second year, they extinguished Zheng, and thus moved their capital to Zheng.

units.zh: 六年，韓嚴弒其君哀侯。
units.en: In the sixth year, Han Yan assassinated his sovereign, Marquis Ai.
units.literal: In the sixth year, Han Yan assassinated his lord Ai Hou.

units.zh: 而子懿侯立。
units.en: His son, Marquis Yi, was then established as ruler.
units.literal: And his son Yi Hou was established.

units.zh: 懿侯二年，魏敗我馬陵。
units.en: During Marquis Yi's second year, Wei defeated Han forces at Maling.
units.literal: In Yi Hou's second year, Wei defeated us at Ma Ling.

units.zh: 五年，與魏惠王會宅陽。
units.en: In the fifth year, they met with King Hui of Wei at Zhaiyang.
units.literal: In the fifth year, they met with Wei Hui Wang at Zhai Yang.

units.zh: 九年，魏敗我澮。
units.en: In the ninth year, Wei defeated Han forces at Kuai.
units.literal: In the ninth year, Wei defeated us at Kuai.

units.zh: 十二年，懿侯卒，子昭侯立。
units.en: In the twelfth year, Marquis Yi died and his son, Marquis Zhao, succeeded him.
units.literal: In the twelfth year, Yi Hou died, and his son Zhao Hou was established.

units.zh: 昭侯元年，秦敗我西山。
units.en: In the first year of Marquis Zhao, Qin defeated Han forces at Xishan.
units.literal: In Zhao Hou's first year, Qin defeated us at Xi Shan.

units.zh: 二年，宋取我黃池。
units.en: The next year, Song captured Han's city of Huangchi.
units.literal: In the second year, Song took our Huang Chi.

units.zh: 魏取朱。
units.en: Wei seized Zhu.
units.literal: Wei took Zhu.

units.zh: 六年，伐東周，取陵觀、邢丘。
units.en: During the sixth year, they attacked Eastern Zhou and captured Lingguan and Xingqiu.
units.literal: In the sixth year, they attacked Eastern Zhou and took Ling Guan and Xing Qiu.

units.zh: 八年，申不害相韓，修術行道，國內以治，諸侯不來侵伐。
units.en: In the eighth year, Shen Buhai became chancellor of Han. He cultivated the art of statecraft and put good governance into practice. The state was well-ordered, and none of the feudal lords dared to invade.
units.literal: In the eighth year, Shen Buhai became chancellor of Han. He cultivated techniques and practiced the way. Within the state there was order, and the feudal lords did not come to invade and attack.

units.zh: 十年，韓姬弒其君悼公。
units.en: In the tenth year, Han Ji assassinated his lord, Marquis Dao.
units.literal: In the tenth year, Han Ji assassinated his lord Dao Gong.

units.zh: 十一年，昭侯如秦。
units.en: In the eleventh year, Marquis Zhao traveled to Qin.
units.literal: In the eleventh year, Zhao Hou went to Qin.

units.zh: 二十二年，申不害死。
units.en: In the twenty-second year, the chancellor Shen Buhai died.
units.literal: In the twenty-second year, Shen Buhai died.

units.zh: 二十四年，秦來拔我宜陽。
units.en: In the twenty-fourth year, Qin came and captured our city of Yiyang.
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, Qin came and captured our Yi Yang.

units.zh: 二十五年，旱，作高門。
units.en: In the twenty-fifth year, there was a drought, yet the marquis ordered the construction of a grand gate.
units.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, there was drought, and they made a high gate.

units.zh: 屈宜臼曰：「昭侯不出此門。
units.en: Qu Yijiu said, "Marquis Zhao will never leave by this gate.
units.literal: Qu Yijiu said, "Marquis Zhao will not pass through this gate.

units.zh: 何也？
units.en: Why do I say this?
units.literal: Why?

units.zh: 不時。
units.en: Because the timing is wrong.
units.literal: Not timely.

units.zh: 吾所謂時者，非時日也，人固有利不利時。
units.en: By timing, I do not mean the calendar. Rather, every person has seasons of fortune and misfortune.
units.literal: What I call timely is not time and day. People indeed have favorable and unfavorable timing.

units.zh: 昭侯嘗利矣，不作高門。
units.en: When Marquis Zhao enjoyed good fortune, he did not build a grand gate.
units.literal: Zhao Hou was once favorable. He did not make a high gate.

units.zh: 往年秦拔宜陽，今年旱，昭侯不以此時卹民之急，而顧益奢，此謂『時絀舉贏』。」
units.en: Last year Qin captured Yiyang; this year there is a drought. Yet rather than relieving the people's hardship in this time of crisis, the marquis indulges in ever greater extravagance. This is what is called 'spending lavishly when the times demand frugality.'"
units.literal: Last year Qin captured Yiyang; this year there is drought. Marquis Zhao does not use this time to relieve the people's distress but instead grows ever more extravagant—this is what is called 'spending lavishly when the times demand frugality.'"

units.zh: 二十六年，高門成，昭侯卒，果不出此門。
units.en: In the twenty-sixth year, workers completed the grand gate. Marquis Zhao died and, as predicted, never once passed through it.
units.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, the high gate was completed. Zhao Hou died, and indeed did not exit this gate.

units.zh: 子宣惠王立。
units.en: His son, King Xuan Hui, succeeded him.
units.literal: His son Xuan Hui Wang was established.

units.zh: 宣惠王五年，張儀相秦。
units.en: In the fifth year of King Xuan Hui, Zhang Yi became chancellor of Qin.
units.literal: In Xuan Hui Wang's fifth year, Zhang Yi became chancellor of Qin.

units.zh: 八年，魏敗我將韓舉。
units.en: In the eighth year, Wei defeated Han forces under the general Han Ju.
units.literal: In the eighth year, Wei defeated our general Han Ju.

units.zh: 十一年，君號為王。
units.en: In the eleventh year, the lord assumed the title of king.
units.literal: In the eleventh year, the lord was titled wang.

units.zh: 與趙會區鼠。
units.en: He met with Zhao at Qushu.
units.literal: They met with Zhao at Qu Shu.

units.zh: 十四，秦伐敗我鄢。
units.en: In the fourteenth year, Qin attacked Han and defeated its army at Yan.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year, Qin attacked and defeated us at Yan.

units.zh: 十六年，秦敗我修魚，虜得韓將鯁、申差於濁澤。
units.en: In the sixteenth year, Qin defeated Han at Xiuyu and captured the Han generals Geng and Shen Chai at Zhuoze.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year, Qin defeated us at Xiu Yu and captured the Han generals Geng and Shen Chai at Zhu Ze.

units.zh: 韓氏急，公仲謂韓王曰：「與國非可恃也。
units.en: The state of Han was in dire straits. Gong Zhong said to the King of Han, "Our allies cannot be relied on.
units.literal: The Han clan was in dire straits. Gong Zhong said to the King of Han, "Allied states cannot be relied upon.

units.zh: 今秦之欲伐楚久矣，王不如因張儀為和於秦，賂以一名都，具甲，與之南伐楚，此以一易二之計也。」
units.en: Qin has long wished to attack Chu. Your Majesty would do better to make peace with Qin through Zhang Yi, offer them one great city, prepare our armor, and join them in a southern campaign against Chu. This is the strategy of trading one to gain two."
units.literal: Qin has long wished to attack Chu. Your Majesty would do better to make peace with Qin through Zhang Yi, offer one famous city as tribute, prepare armor, and join them in a southern campaign against Chu—this is the strategy of trading one to gain two."

units.zh: 韓王曰：「善。」
units.en: The King of Han said, "Very well."
units.literal: The King of Han said, "Good."

units.zh: 乃警公仲之行，將西購於秦。
units.en: They then prepared Gong Zhong's mission, intending to negotiate terms with Qin in the west.
units.literal: Thus, they prepared Gong Zhong's journey, about to negotiate with Qin in the west.

units.zh: 楚王聞之大恐，召陳軫告之。
units.en: When the King of Chu learned of this, he was greatly alarmed. He summoned Chen Zhen and informed him.
units.literal: The King of Chu heard this and was greatly alarmed. He summoned Chen Zhen and told him of it.

units.zh: 陳軫曰：「秦之欲伐楚久矣，今又得韓之名都一而具甲，秦韓并兵而伐楚，此秦所禱祀而求也。
units.en: Chen Zhen said, "Qin has long desired to attack Chu. Now they have also obtained a great city from Han and armed their forces. If Qin and Han combine their armies to invade Chu, it will be the very thing Qin has prayed to the gods for.
units.literal: Chen Zhen said, "Qin has long wished to attack Chu. Now they have also obtained one famous city from Han and equipped their armor. If Qin and Han combine their troops to attack Chu, this is what Qin has prayed for at the altars.

units.zh: 今已得之矣，楚國必伐矣。
units.en: Now that they have obtained it, Chu will certainly be invaded.
units.literal: Now they have already obtained it. Chu will certainly be attacked.

units.zh: 王聽臣為之警四境之內，起師言救韓，命戰車滿道路，發信臣，多其車，重其幣，使信王之救己也。
units.en: If Your Majesty heeds my counsel, alert the troops within our borders, raise an army under the banner of rescuing Han, fill the roads with war chariots, and dispatch trusted envoys with lavish gifts, so that Han will believe Your Majesty intends to come to their aid.
units.literal: Your Majesty listen to this minister and for it alert within the four borders, raise troops saying they save Han, order chariots to fill the roads, send trusted ministers with many chariots and heavy gifts, making them believe the wang will save them.

units.zh: 縱韓不能聽我，韓必德王也，必不為鴈行以來，是秦韓不和也，兵雖至，楚不大病也。
units.en: Even if Han does not heed us, they will be grateful to Your Majesty and will not march in formation alongside Qin. This means Qin and Han will not act in concert. Even if their troops come, Chu will suffer no serious harm.
units.literal: Even if Han cannot listen to us, Han will certainly feel grateful to the wang and will not come in wild goose formation. This means Qin and Han are not harmonious. Though troops arrive, Chu will not be greatly harmed.

units.zh: 為能聽我絕和於秦，秦必大怒，以厚怨韓。
units.en: If Han does heed us and breaks off peace with Qin, then Qin will be furious and bear deep resentment toward Han.
units.literal: If they can listen to us and cut peace with Qin, Qin will certainly be greatly angry and harbor thick resentment toward Han.

units.zh: 韓之南交楚，必輕秦；
units.en: If Han allies with Chu in the south, they will inevitably slight Qin;
units.literal: Han south ally Chu, must slight Qin;

units.zh: 輕秦，其應秦必不敬：是因秦、韓之兵而免楚國之患也。」
units.en: if they slight Qin, their response to Qin will surely be disrespectful, and thus we may use the rift between Qin and Han to free Chu from danger."
units.literal: Slight Qin, their respond Qin must not respectful: this through Qin, Han troops avoid Chu state calamity.'

units.zh: 楚王曰：「善。」
units.en: The King of Chu said, "Excellent."
units.literal: The King of Chu said, "Good."

units.zh: 乃警四境之內，興師言救韓。
units.en: They then mobilized troops throughout the kingdom and raised an army, proclaiming that they would rescue Han.
units.literal: Thus, they alerted within the four borders and raised troops, saying they would save Han.

units.zh: 命戰車滿道路，發信臣，多其車，重其幣。
units.en: They ordered war chariots to fill the roads and dispatched trusted envoys with grand retinues and lavish gifts.
units.literal: They ordered chariots to fill the roads and sent trusted ministers with many chariots and heavy gifts.

units.zh: 謂韓王曰：「不穀國雖小，已悉發之矣。
units.en: The envoys told the King of Han, "Though our humble kingdom is small, we have already mobilized every soldier.
units.literal: They told the King of Han, "Though our unworthy state is small, we have already mobilized everything.

units.zh: 願大國遂肆志於秦，不穀將以楚殉韓。」
units.en: We hope Your Majesty's great state will press forward against Qin without restraint. Our humble king will commit Chu to Han's cause."
units.literal: Wish great state freely vent will on Qin, unworthy will with Chu follow Han.'

units.zh: 韓王聞之大說，乃止公仲之行。
units.en: When the King of Han heard this, he was greatly pleased and called off Gong Zhong's mission.
units.literal: The King of Han heard this and was greatly pleased, and so he stopped Gong Zhong's mission.

units.zh: 公仲曰：「不可。
units.en: Gong Zhong said, "No, Your Majesty must not do this.
units.literal: Gong Zhong said, "This must not be done.

units.zh: 夫以實伐我者秦也，以虛名救我者楚也。
units.en: It is Qin that attacks us with real force; it is Chu that rescues us with empty promises.
units.literal: The one attacking us with reality is Qin. The one saving us with empty name is Chu.

units.zh: 王恃楚之虛名，而輕絕彊秦之敵，王必為天下大笑。
units.en: If Your Majesty relies on Chu's empty promises and carelessly breaks with mighty Qin, you will surely become the laughingstock of the realm.
units.literal: The wang relying on Chu's empty name, lightly cutting alliance with strong Qin - the wang will certainly become the world's great laughingstock.

units.zh: 且楚韓非兄弟之國也，又非素約而謀伐秦也。
units.en: Moreover, Chu and Han are not brother states, nor have they been longstanding allies plotting against Qin.
units.literal: Moreover, Chu and Han are not brother states, and moreover they are not long-time allies who planned to attack Qin.

units.zh: 已有伐形，因發兵言救韓，此必陳軫之謀也。
units.en: They already show every sign of military aggression, yet they send troops claiming to rescue Han. This must be a stratagem devised by Chen Zhen.
units.literal: They already have the outward marks of war, yet they send troops claiming to rescue Han. This must be Chen Zhen's stratagem.

units.zh: 且王已使人報於秦矣，今不行，是欺秦也。
units.en: Besides, Your Majesty has already sent word to Qin. To reverse course now would be to deceive them.
units.literal: Moreover, the wang has already sent people to report to Qin. Now not going would be deceiving Qin.

units.zh: 夫輕欺彊秦而信楚之謀臣，恐王必悔之。」
units.en: If you recklessly deceive mighty Qin while trusting a Chu strategist, I fear Your Majesty will come to regret this deeply."
units.literal: Lightly deceive strong Qin trust Chu strategist minister, fear wang must regret it.'

units.zh: 韓王不聽，遂絕於秦。
units.en: The King of Han would not listen, and so he broke off relations with Qin.
units.literal: The King of Han would not listen and thus broke off relations with Qin.

units.zh: 秦因大怒，益甲伐韓，大戰，楚救不至韓。
units.en: Qin was enraged, reinforced its armies, and attacked Han. A great battle ensued, but Chu's promised relief forces never arrived.
units.literal: Qin thus became greatly angry, increased its armor and attacked Han. There was a great battle, but Chu's rescue did not arrive at Han.

units.zh: 十九年，大破我岸門。
units.en: In the nineteenth year, they inflicted a devastating defeat on us at Anmen.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year, they greatly broke our An Men.

units.zh: 太子倉質於秦以和。
units.en: The crown prince Cang was sent as a hostage to Qin to sue for peace.
units.literal: Crown prince Cang became a hostage in Qin for peace.

units.zh: 二十一年，與秦共攻楚，敗楚將屈丐，斬首八萬於丹陽。
units.en: In the twenty-first year, they joined Qin in attacking Chu, defeated the Chu general Qu Gai, and took eighty thousand heads at Danyang.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year, they attacked Chu together with Qin, defeated Chu general Qu Gai, and beheaded eighty thousand at Dan Yang.

units.zh: 是歲，宣惠王卒，太子倉立，是為襄王。
units.en: That year, King Xuan Hui died. The crown prince Cang succeeded him and became King Xiang.
units.literal: This year, Xuan Hui Wang died. Crown prince Cang was established, called Xiang Wang.

units.zh: 襄王四年，與秦武王會臨晉。
units.en: In the fourth year of King Xiang, he met with King Wu of Qin at Linjin.
units.literal: In Xiang Wang's fourth year, they met with Qin Wu Wang at Lin Jin.

units.zh: 其秋，秦使甘茂攻我宜陽。
units.en: That autumn, Qin sent Gan Mao to attack our city of Yiyang.
units.literal: That autumn, Qin sent Gan Mao to attack our Yi Yang.

units.zh: 五年，秦拔我宜陽，斬首六萬。
units.en: In the fifth year, Qin captured our Yiyang and took sixty thousand heads.
units.literal: In the fifth year, Qin captured our Yi Yang and beheaded sixty thousand.

units.zh: 秦武王卒。
units.en: King Wu of Qin died.
units.literal: Qin Wu Wang died.

units.zh: 六年，秦復與我武遂。
units.en: In the sixth year, Qin returned Wusui to us.
units.literal: In the sixth year, Qin again gave us Wu Sui.

units.zh: 九年，秦復取我武遂。
units.en: In the ninth year, Qin took Wusui from us once again.
units.literal: In the ninth year, Qin again took our Wu Sui.

units.zh: 十年，太子嬰朝秦而歸。
units.en: In the tenth year, the crown prince Ying attended an audience at the Qin court and returned.
units.literal: In the tenth year, crown prince Ying went for audience in Qin and returned.

units.zh: 十一年，秦伐我，取穰。
units.en: In the eleventh year, Qin attacked us and captured Rang.
units.literal: In the eleventh year, Qin attacked us and took Rang.

units.zh: 與秦伐楚，敗楚將唐眛。
units.en: They joined Qin in attacking Chu and defeated the Chu general Tang Mei.
units.literal: They attacked Chu with Qin and defeated Chu general Tang Mei.

units.zh: 十二年，太子嬰死。
units.en: In the twelfth year, the crown prince Ying died.
units.literal: In the twelfth year, crown prince Ying died.

units.zh: 公子咎、公子蟣蝨爭為太子。
units.en: Prince Jiu and Prince Ji Shi contended for the position of crown prince.
units.literal: Prince Jiu and Prince Jishi contended to become crown prince.

units.zh: 時蟣蝨質於楚。
units.en: At that time, Jishi was held as a hostage in Chu.
units.literal: At the time, Jiu Jie was a hostage in Chu.

units.zh: 蘇代謂韓咎曰：「蟣蝨亡在楚，楚王欲內之甚。
units.en: Su Dai said to Han Jiu, "Ji Shi has fled and is in Chu, and the King of Chu is very eager to install him.
units.literal: Su Dai said to Han Jiu, "Ji Shi has fled and is in Chu, and the King of Chu is very eager to bring him in.

units.zh: 今楚兵十餘萬在方城之外，公何不令楚王筑萬室之都雍氏之旁，韓必起兵以救之，公必將矣。
units.en: Now Chu has over a hundred thousand troops beyond Fangcheng. Why not have the King of Chu build a great city beside Yongshi? Han will surely raise an army to counter it, and you, my lord, will certainly be given command of the forces.
units.literal: Now Chu has over one hundred thousand troops outside Fang Cheng. Why doesn't the duke order the Chu wang to build a city of ten thousand rooms beside Yong Shi? Han will certainly raise troops to save it, and the duke will certainly be the general.

units.zh: 公因以韓楚之兵奉蟣蝨而內之，其聽公必矣，必以楚韓封公也。」
units.en: Then you can use the combined forces of Han and Chu to escort Ji Shi and install him as heir. He will certainly heed your counsel, and Chu and Han will surely grant you a fief in return."
units.literal: Duke thus with Han Chu troops support Jiu Jie take him in, he listen duke must, must with Chu Han enfeoff duke.'

units.zh: 韓咎從其計。
units.en: Han Jiu followed this plan.
units.literal: Han Jiu followed his plan.

units.zh: 楚圍雍氏，韓求救於秦。
units.en: Chu besieged Yongshi, and Han appealed to Qin for help.
units.literal: Chu besieged Yong Shi, and Han sought rescue from Qin.

units.zh: 秦未為發，使公孫昧入韓。
units.en: Qin had not yet dispatched troops, but sent Gongsun Mei to Han.
units.literal: Qin had not yet sent troops and sent Gongsun Mei to enter Han.

units.zh: 公仲曰：「子以秦為且救韓乎？」
units.en: Gong Zhong asked, "Do you suppose Qin is really about to rescue Han?"
units.literal: Gong Zhong asked, "Do you think Qin will actually come to rescue Han?"

units.zh: 對曰：「秦王之言曰『請道南鄭、藍田，出兵於楚以待公』，殆不合矣。」
units.en: Gongsun Mei replied, "The King of Qin says he will march through Nanzheng and Lantian, deploy troops against Chu, and await your forces there—but I doubt this will come to pass."
units.literal: He replied, "The King of Qin said, 'Please open the route through Nanzheng and Lantian; I will send troops against Chu to await you'—but that will probably not come to pass."

units.zh: 公仲曰：「子以為果乎？」
units.en: Gong Zhong asked, "Do you truly believe that?"
units.literal: Gong Zhong said: 'You think truly?'

units.zh: 對曰：「秦王必祖張儀之故智。
units.en: Gongsun Mei replied, "The King of Qin will surely follow the old stratagem of Zhang Yi.
units.literal: He replied, "The King of Qin will surely follow Zhang Yi's old stratagem.

units.zh: 楚威王攻梁也，張儀謂秦王曰：『與楚攻魏，魏折而入於楚，韓固其與國也，是秦孤也。
units.en: When King Wei of Chu attacked Liang, Zhang Yi told the King of Qin, 'If Qin joins Chu in attacking Wei, Wei will break and submit to Chu; Han is already Wei's ally, so Qin will be left isolated.
units.literal: When King Wei of Chu attacked Liang, Zhang Yi told the King of Qin: if Qin joined Chu in attacking Wei, Wei would break and submit to Chu; Han was already Wei's allied state, so Qin would be isolated.

units.zh: 不如出兵以到之，魏楚大戰，秦取西河之外以歸。』
units.en: It would be better to deploy troops as a show of force. While Wei and Chu exhaust themselves in battle, Qin can seize the lands beyond the West River and return home.'
units.literal: It would be better to send troops as a show of force. While Wei and Chu fought a great battle, Qin could seize the lands beyond the West River and return.

units.zh: 今其狀陽言與韓，其實陰善楚。
units.en: Now Qin outwardly professes alliance with Han, but in truth secretly favors Chu.
units.literal: Now their appearance openly says alliance with Han, but actually secretly favors Chu.

units.zh: 公待秦而到，必輕與楚戰。
units.en: If you wait for Qin's forces to arrive, you will surely rush into battle with Chu without caution.
units.literal: The duke waits for Qin to arrive and will certainly lightly battle with Chu.

units.zh: 楚陰得秦之不用也，必易與公相支也。
units.en: Chu will secretly know that Qin has no intention of intervening, and will find it easy to hold out against you.
units.literal: Chu secretly gets that Qin will not be used and will certainly easily support the duke.

units.zh: 公戰而勝楚，遂與公乘楚，施三川而歸。
units.en: If you fight and defeat Chu, Qin will then join you in pursuing the victory over Chu, seize the Three Rivers region, and go home.
units.literal: The duke battles and wins against Chu, thus rides with the duke on Chu, bestows San Chuan and returns.

units.zh: 公戰不勝楚，楚塞三川守之，公不能救也。
units.en: If you fight but fail to defeat Chu, then Chu will block the Three Rivers region and hold it, and you will be unable to recover it.
units.literal: If you fight but do not defeat Chu, Chu will block the Three Passes and hold them, and you cannot recover them.

units.zh: 竊為公患之。
units.en: I am deeply worried about you on this account.
units.literal: I secretly worry for the duke about it.

units.zh: 司馬庚三反於郢，甘茂與昭魚遇於商於，其言收璽，實類有約也。」
units.en: Sima Geng has traveled to Ying three times; Gan Mao has met Zhao Yu at Shangyu. Though they speak of recovering seals, it appears they have already reached a secret agreement."
units.literal: Sima Geng three times return Ying, Gan Mao with Zhao Yu meet Shang Yu, their words take seal, actually similar have agreement.'

units.zh: 公仲恐，曰：「然則柰何？」
units.en: Gong Zhong grew alarmed and asked, "Then what should we do?"
units.literal: Gong Zhong grew alarmed and said, "Then what should we do?"

units.zh: 曰：「公必先韓而後秦，先身而後張儀。
units.en: Gongsun Mei said, "You must put Han first and Qin second, your own interests before those of Zhang Yi.
units.literal: Gongsun Mei said, "You must put Han before Qin, and your own interests before Zhang Yi's.

units.zh: 公不如亟以國合於齊楚，齊楚必委國於公。
units.en: You had better make haste to align the state with Qi and Chu. Qi and Chu will surely entrust matters of state to you.
units.literal: The duke should quickly unite the state with Qi and Chu. Qi and Chu will certainly entrust the state to the duke.

units.zh: 公之所惡者張儀也，其實猶不無秦也。」
units.en: What you truly oppose is Zhang Yi, not Qin itself. Even so, you need not cut ties with Qin entirely."
units.literal: Duke what hate Zhang Yi, actually still not without Qin.'

units.zh: 於是楚解雍氏圍。
units.en: Thereupon Chu lifted the siege of Yongshi.
units.literal: Thus, Chu lifted the siege of Yong Shi.

units.zh: 蘇代又謂秦太后弟羋戎曰：「公叔伯嬰恐秦楚之內蟣蝨也，公何不為韓求質子於楚？
units.en: Su Dai then said to Mi Rong, the brother of the Queen Mother of Qin, "Gongshu Boying fears that Qin and Chu will install Ji Shi. Why do you not seek a hostage from Chu on Han's behalf?
units.literal: Su Dai again told Qin queen mother younger brother Mi Yong said: 'Gong Shu Bo Ying fear Qin Chu take in Jiu Jie, duke why not for Han seek hostage from Chu?

units.zh: 楚王聽入質子於韓，則公叔伯嬰知秦楚之不以蟣蝨為事，必以韓合於秦楚。
units.en: If the King of Chu agrees to send a hostage to Han, then Gongshu Boying will know that Qin and Chu have no intention of using Ji Shi, and he will surely align Han with Qin and Chu.
units.literal: If the Chu wang listens and sends a hostage to Han, then Gong Shu Bo Ying will know that Qin and Chu do not regard Jiu Jie as the matter, and will certainly unite Han with Qin and Chu.

units.zh: 秦楚挾韓以窘魏，魏氏不敢合於齊，是齊孤也。
units.en: With Qin and Chu flanking Han, Wei will be cornered. Wei will not dare ally with Qi, and thus Qi will be left isolated.
units.literal: Qin and Chu holding Han will distress Wei. The Wei clan will not dare unite with Qi. This isolates Qi.

units.zh: 公又為秦求質子於楚，楚不聽，怨結於韓。
units.en: If you also seek a hostage from Chu on behalf of Qin and Chu refuses, then Chu's resentment will fall upon Han.
units.literal: The duke moreover seeks a hostage from Chu for Qin. Chu does not listen, and resentment ties to Han.

units.zh: 韓挾齊魏以圍楚，楚必重公。
units.en: If Han, backed by Qi and Wei, threatens Chu, then Chu will surely value you all the more.
units.literal: Han holding Qi and Wei to surround Chu, Chu will certainly respect the duke.

units.zh: 公挾秦楚之重以積德於韓，公叔伯嬰必以國待公。」
units.en: If you leverage the weight of Qin and Chu to accumulate goodwill with Han, Gongshu Boying will certainly entrust the affairs of the state to you."
units.literal: Duke hold Qin Chu importance accumulate virtue Han, Gong Shu Bo Ying must with state await duke.'

units.zh: 於是蟣蝨竟不得歸韓。
units.en: In the end, Ji Shi was never able to return to Han.
units.literal: Thus, Jiu Jie finally was not able to return to Han.

units.zh: 韓立咎為太子。
units.en: Han established Jiu as the crown prince.
units.literal: Han established Jiu as crown prince.

units.zh: 齊、魏王來。
units.en: The kings of Qi and Wei came to visit.
units.literal: The Qi and Wei wang came.

units.zh: 十四年，與齊、魏王共擊秦，至函谷而軍焉。
units.en: During the fourteenth year, together with the kings of Qi and Wei, they attacked Qin and advanced to Hangu Pass, where they encamped.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year, together with the Qi and Wei wang they attacked Qin, arrived at Han Gu and stationed there.

units.zh: 十六年，秦與我河外及武遂。
units.en: In the sixteenth year, Qin returned to us the lands beyond the Yellow River and Wusui.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year, Qin gave us lands outside the He and Wu Sui.

units.zh: 襄王卒，太子咎立，是為釐王。
units.en: King Xiang died, and the crown prince Jiu succeeded him, becoming King Xi.
units.literal: Xiang Wang died. Crown prince Jiu was established, called Xi Wang.

units.zh: 釐王三年，使公孫喜率周、魏攻秦。
units.en: In the third year of King Xi, he sent Gongsun Xi to lead the forces of Zhou and Wei in an attack on Qin.
units.literal: In Xi Wang's third year, he sent Gongsun Xi to lead Zhou and Wei in attacking Qin.

units.zh: 秦敗我二十四萬，虜喜伊闕。
units.en: Qin defeated our army of two hundred and forty thousand and captured Gongsun Xi at the Battle of Yique.
units.literal: Qin defeated our two hundred forty thousand and captured Xi at Yi Que.

units.zh: 五年，秦拔我宛。
units.en: In the fifth year, Qin captured Han's city of Wan.
units.literal: In the fifth year, Qin captured our Wan.

units.zh: 六年，與秦武遂地二百里。
units.en: The next year, they ceded two hundred li of the Wusui territory to Qin.
units.literal: In the sixth year, they gave Qin two hundred li of Wu Sui land.

units.zh: 十年，秦敗我師于夏山。
units.en: During the tenth year, Qin defeated Han's army at Xiashan.
units.literal: In the tenth year, Qin defeated our army at Xia Shan.

units.zh: 十二年，與秦昭王會西周而佐秦攻齊。
units.en: During the twelfth year, they met with King Zhao of Qin at Western Zhou and assisted Qin in attacking Qi.
units.literal: In the twelfth year, they met with Qin Zhao Wang at Xi Zhou and assisted Qin in attacking Qi.

units.zh: 齊敗，湣王出亡。
units.en: Qi suffered defeat, and King Min fled into exile.
units.literal: Qi was defeated, and Min Wang fled.

units.zh: 十四年，與秦會兩周閒。
units.en: Two years later, they met with Qin in the region between the two Zhou capitals.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year, they met with Qin between the two Zhou.

units.zh: 二十一年，使暴捐救魏，為秦所敗，捐走開封。
units.en: During the twenty-first year, Han sent Bao Juan to rescue Wei, but Qin defeated him, and Bao Juan fled to Kaifeng.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year, he sent Bao Juan to save Wei. He was defeated by Qin, and Juan fled to Kai Feng.

units.zh: 二十三年，趙、魏攻我華陽。
units.en: In the twenty-third year, Zhao and Wei attacked Han's city of Huayang.
units.literal: In the twenty-third year, Zhao and Wei attacked our Hua Yang.

units.zh: 韓告急於秦，秦不救。
units.en: Han sent an urgent appeal to Qin, but Qin did not come to their aid.
units.literal: Han reported urgency to Qin, but Qin did not save them.

units.zh: 韓相國謂陳筮曰：「事急，願公雖病，為一宿之行。」
units.en: The Han chancellor said to Chen Shi, "The situation is desperate. I implore you, even though you are ill, to make the overnight journey to Qin."
units.literal: The Han chancellor said to Chen Shi, "The matter is urgent. Though you are ill, I beg you to make a journey of one night."

units.zh: 陳筮見穰侯。
units.en: Chen Shi went and had an audience with the Marquis of Rang.
units.literal: Chen Shi saw Rang Hou.

units.zh: 穰侯曰：「事急乎？
units.en: The Marquis of Rang asked, "Is the matter truly urgent?
units.literal: Rang Hou said: 'Matter urgent?

units.zh: 故使公來。」
units.en: Is that why they sent you here?"
units.literal: Thus, sent duke come.'

units.zh: 陳筮曰：「未急也。」
units.en: Chen Shi replied, "Not yet."
units.literal: Chen Shi said: 'Not yet urgent.'

units.zh: 穰侯怒曰：「是可以為公之主使乎？
units.en: The Marquis of Rang said angrily, "Is this any way to serve as envoy for your lord?
units.literal: The Marquis of Rang said angrily, "Is this how an envoy of your lord may behave?

units.zh: 夫冠蓋相望，告敝邑甚急，公來言未急，何也？」
units.en: Envoy after envoy has come, all reporting that your state is in the direst straits. Yet you arrive and say the matter is not urgent. Why?"
units.literal: Envoy after envoy has come, all reporting that your state is in dire straits. Yet you arrive and say the matter is not urgent—why?"

units.zh: 陳筮曰：「彼韓急則將變而佗從，以未急，故復來耳。」
units.en: Chen Shi said, "If Han were truly desperate, it would have already switched allegiance to another power. Precisely because the matter is not yet beyond hope, I have come once more."
units.literal: Chen Shi said, "If Han were truly desperate, it would already have switched allegiance to another power. Precisely because the matter is not yet beyond hope, I have come once more."

units.zh: 穰侯曰：「公無見王，請今發兵救韓。」
units.en: The Marquis of Rang said, "You need not see the king. I will send troops to rescue Han at once."
units.literal: The Marquis of Rang said, "You need not see the king; I will send troops to rescue Han at once."

units.zh: 八日而至，敗趙、魏於華陽之下。
units.en: The troops arrived in eight days and defeated Zhao and Wei beneath the walls of Huayang.
units.literal: They arrived in eight days and defeated Zhao and Wei below Hua Yang.

units.zh: 是歲，釐王卒，子桓惠王立。
units.en: That year, King Xi died, and his son, King Huan Hui, succeeded him.
units.literal: This year, Xi Wang died. His son Huan Hui Wang was established.

units.zh: 桓惠王元年，伐燕。
units.en: During the first year of King Huan Hui, they attacked Yan.
units.literal: In Huan Hui Wang's first year, they attacked Yan.

units.zh: 九年，秦拔我陘，城汾旁。
units.en: In the ninth year, Qin captured Han's Xing and fortified a city beside the Fen River.
units.literal: In the ninth year, Qin captured our Xing and built a city beside the Fen.

units.zh: 十年，秦擊我於太行，我上黨郡守以上黨郡降趙。
units.en: During the tenth year, Qin attacked Han at the Taihang Mountains. The governor of Han's Shangdang Commandery surrendered the entire commandery to Zhao.
units.literal: In the tenth year, Qin attacked us at Tai Hang. Our Shang Dang commandery governor surrendered the Shang Dang commandery to Zhao.

units.zh: 十四年，秦拔趙上黨，殺馬服子卒四十餘萬於長平。
units.en: In the fourteenth year, Qin captured Zhao's Shangdang and slaughtered over four hundred thousand of Zhao Kuo's soldiers at the Battle of Changping.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year, Qin captured Zhao's Shang Dang and killed over four hundred thousand of Ma Fu Zi's troops at Chang Ping.

units.zh: 十七年，秦拔我陽城、負黍。
units.en: In the seventeenth year, Qin captured Han's Yangcheng and Fushu.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year, Qin captured our Yang Cheng and Fu Shu.

units.zh: 二十二年，秦昭王卒。
units.en: In the twenty-second year, King Zhao of Qin died.
units.literal: In the twenty-second year, Qin Zhao Wang died.

units.zh: 二十四年，秦拔我城皋、滎陽。
units.en: In the twenty-fourth year, Qin captured Han's Chenggao and Xingyang.
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, Qin captured our Cheng Gao and Xing Yang.

units.zh: 二十六年，秦悉拔我上黨。
units.en: In the twenty-sixth year, Qin completely overran Han's Shangdang territory.
units.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, Qin completely captured our Shang Dang.

units.zh: 二十九年，秦拔我十三城。
units.en: In the twenty-ninth year, Qin seized thirteen Han cities.
units.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, Qin captured thirteen of our cities.

units.zh: 三十四年，桓惠王卒，子王安立。
units.en: In the thirty-fourth year, King Huan Hui died, and his son, King An, succeeded him.
units.literal: In the thirty-fourth year, Huan Hui Wang died. His son Wang An was established.

units.zh: 王安五年，秦攻韓，韓急，使韓非使秦，秦留非，因殺之。
units.en: In the fifth year of King An, Qin attacked Han. In desperation, Han sent Han Fei as envoy to Qin. Qin detained Han Fei and eventually had him killed.
units.literal: In Wang An's fifth year, Qin attacked Han. Han was urgent and sent Han Fei as envoy to Qin. Qin detained Fei and thus killed him.

units.zh: 九年，秦虜王安，盡入其地，為潁州郡。
units.en: In the ninth year, Qin took King An captive, annexed all of Han's remaining territory, and made it the Yingchuan Commandery.
units.literal: In the ninth year, Qin captured Wang An, completely entered their territory, and made it the Ying province commandery.

units.zh: 韓遂亡。
units.en: Thus, the state of Han came to an end.
units.literal: Han thus perished.

units.zh: 太史公曰：韓厥之感晉景公，紹趙孤之子武，以成程嬰、公孫杵臼之義，此天下之陰德也。
units.en: The Grand Historian remarks: Han Jue moved Duke Jing of Jin to restore the orphan Zhao Wu, thereby fulfilling the righteous pledge of Cheng Ying and Gongsun Chujiu. This was a hidden virtue that resonated throughout the realm.
units.literal: The Grand Historian said: Han Jue moved Duke Jing of Jin, restored the orphan Zhao Wu, and thereby fulfilled the righteousness of Cheng Ying and Gongsun Chujiu—this was a hidden virtue under Heaven.

units.zh: 韓氏之功，於晉未睹其大者也。
units.en: As for the Han clan's accomplishments in Jin, none had seemed especially great.
units.literal: The Han clan's accomplishments in Jin were not seen to be great.

units.zh: 然與趙、魏終為諸侯十餘世，宜乎哉！
units.en: Yet together with Zhao and Wei, they endured as feudal lords for more than ten generations—and rightly so!
units.literal: Yet together with Zhao and Wei they finally became feudal lords for more than ten generations—fitting indeed!
